general_rules.name: internal_vs_external_signature
general_rules.description: Use abbreviated signature 'J.' or 'Cheers, J.' with internal colleagues (strategyco.com domain). Use full formal signature block with title and company for external clients and partners.
general_rules.action: Internal: sign 'J.' or 'Cheers, J.' | External: sign 'Best regards, James Conseil / Senior Consultant / StrategyCo | London'

general_rules.name: structured_bullet_points_internal
general_rules.description: Use bullet points and structured lists extensively in internal communications, especially for updates, action items, and multi-point requests
general_rules.action: Format content as bulleted lists with clear, concise points and action items

general_rules.name: numbered_formal_structure_external
general_rules.description: Use numbered sections and formal paragraph structure for external client communications, especially proposals and strategic documents
general_rules.trigger: External client email with strategic content
general_rules.action: Structure content with numbered sections (1., 2., 3.) and complete sentences in paragraph form

general_rules.name: gratitude_opening_external
general_rules.description: Open external client emails with gratitude or acknowledgment ('Thank you for...', 'I appreciate...', 'Thank you for the detailed feedback')
general_rules.action: Begin with a thank-you statement acknowledging the client's previous message or action

general_rules.name: direct_imperative_tone_internal
general_rules.description: Use direct imperative verbs and short requests with internal team ('Please pull together', 'Can you refine', 'Prepare your 5-min intro')
general_rules.action: Use imperative mood, direct requests without extensive preamble

general_rules.name: diplomatic_language_external
general_rules.description: Use diplomatic, consultative language with external clients ('I would suggest', 'I propose', 'We recommend', 'You raise an excellent point')
general_rules.trigger: External client recommendation or feedback response
general_rules.action: Frame recommendations as suggestions, acknowledge client input diplomatically

general_rules.name: deadline_clarity
general_rules.description: Always specify clear deadlines and timeframes for deliverables ('by Wednesday', 'by Friday', 'by close of business on the 14th')
general_rules.trigger: Email containing action items or deliverable requests
general_rules.action: Include specific deadline with each request (day, date, or time)

general_rules.name: subject_line_brevity
general_rules.description: Keep subject lines brief and project-focused, often using 'Re:' format with project name and topic ('Re: AcmeCorp Engagement Update', 'Q2 pipeline and staffing')
general_rules.action: Use concise subject lines with project context, avoid lengthy descriptions

general_rules.name: no_emoji_usage
general_rules.description: Never use emoji in any professional communication, internal or external
general_rules.action: Avoid emoji entirely, maintain text-only professional communication

general_rules.name: encouragement_peer_communication
general_rules.description: Use encouraging, positive language with peers and international colleagues ('Brilliant news', 'Good work', 'Nice job today', 'Go get it')
general_rules.trigger: Communication with peers or recognition of good work
general_rules.action: Include brief positive reinforcement and encouragement
